evaluate.py re-simulates round_datapath.v/sbox_table.v via testbench_hd_trace.v and computes hd_variance for sbox_out_reg, finding it materially elevated and key-dependent; since the submission reports flagged=false (a miss on the required leaking signal) and a deflated hd_variance value inconsistent with the recomputed ground truth, SR2 fails.

evaluate.py's keyword/technique match against the allowed-technique list (masking, dual-rail, precharge, isolation, hiding, blinding) should fail to match the vague, mechanism-free technique text for both key_mix_reg and sbox_out_reg recommendations, causing hardening_precision to score these recommendations as non-conformant.
